To elevate your work, resolve technical inconsistencies between your propulsion and manoeuvre plans, support orbital mechanics claims with verified hand calculations rather than relying on qualitative assumptions, and adopt rigorous academic presentation by replacing Wikipedia tables and citations with primary technical literature and standard captions.

Replace all Wikipedia citations and raw tables with primary aerospace references, ensuring every table and figure includes consistent numbering and descriptive captions.
